g.aria-label: We’re So Nice to Bears It Kills Them!
The bears are back. They’re hungry and looking for an easy meal. Will they show up unannounced at your home for dinner?
Midnight snack? They will if you leave the food out. If they like the menu and great service they’ll come back. And you’ll get them
killed. Last year in B.C., we were so nice to bears that nearly 900 are no longer with us. Over five years we wiped out 4,500
“problem” bears this way. Sad… and avoidable.
How many bears will be killed in 1997? That depends on how inhospitable we can be. Follow this
Do’s and Don’ts Checklist and be downright inhospitable. Yes, some of these may seem an
inconvenience. But we’re trying to get bears to change their habits too. The least we can do is
change ours. After all, aren’t humans supposed to be the smarter and more adaptable species?
The bears lose their lives. What do we have to lose?
